channel.title: Sample Matters
channel.description: Sample Matters, the Pro-curo fortnightly briefing, from Pro-curo Software Limited.

item.title: MHRA GCP inspections, lab automation and tissue data reuse
item.description: The MHRA's GCP guidance names laboratories analysing clinical trial samples among the organisations that must comply, so its trial master file and dossier expectations reach sample teams as well as sponsors. The clinical laboratory at the Hôpital Européen Georges Pompidou (AP-HP) sets each aliquot's destruction date from the legal retention period at registration, a model to compare with how a collection tracks retention deadlines today. HuBMAP and a specimen supplier both treat provenance from donor to sample to derived data as the record that decides whether material can be trusted and reused.

item.title: HTA annual report, CE marked devices and biobank networks
item.description: The HTA ran 226 planned regulatory assessments in 2025/26 and kept two-person unannounced inspections in the post-mortem sector because of ongoing high levels of risk, incidents and shortfalls. The HTARI incident reporting system went live for the Anatomy sector on 1 December 2025, and a multi-year Codes of Practice review plus SoHO preparation for Northern Ireland from August 2027 mean guidance that local procedures cite will be revised. The government intends to recognise CE marked medical and IVD devices in Great Britain indefinitely, with UK responsible person, MHRA registration and post-market surveillance duties still applying to manufacturers.
